author: DistantVerse

author: DistantVerse
quote:
Realism is pretty, but not fun.

As developers, you guys have lost track of what if means to make games. You're not supposed to be making games for yourself, you're making a game to entertain your customers.

It is not for the sake of pleasing journalists.
It is not for the sake of not offending your team.
It is not for the sake of taking views on the internet but be unplayable at under 30 fps.

It is purely for the sake of allowing your players to have a good experience with the game they purchased.

That is what Asian companies understand but Rockstar and western companies as a whole forgot: the players are always first and foremost, and a video game's sole reason of existence is to the service of your players.

If journalists are able to say that the game isn't perfect but give a 100, allow me to say that some parts of the game are ok but give a 0.

That's only fair.
